Please start on Zillow and search Grand Rapids rentals with the monthly rent set between $1,400 and $2,400, then open one listing that looks like a real option in its own tab so I can see the photos and map, and grab the basics for it like the address, monthly price, and the Zillow listing page. Use that exact monthly rent as the benchmark for whether a trailer or other small living setup would actually save me money, then go to Craigslist for Grand Rapids and find at least three listings that seem suitable for living in and are priced below that Zillow benchmark; open the actual posting pages so you can verify they’re still live and note each title, price, and link. After that, because I may need somewhere temporary while I travel to inspect options, go to Booking.com and look up a hotel in Grand Rapids with visible guest reviews, open the property page, and summarize the overall guest review score plus at least three takeaways from recent reviews so I can tell what staying there would really be like. Here is the Grand Rapids housing comparison, live listing benchmarks, hotel review summary, and recommendations based on the live searches.

---

### Open Tabs Reference
- **Tab ID 103795259**: Zillow Rental Listing — Diamond Place Apartments
  - **URL**: https://www.zillow.com/apartments/grand-rapids-mi/diamond-place-apartments/CkCSnD/
- **Tab ID 103795260**: Booking.com Hotel Page — Country Inn & Suites by Radisson, Grand Rapids East, MI
  - **URL**: https://www.booking.com/hotel/us/country-inn-suites-by-carlson-grand-rapids.html#tab-reviews
- **Tab ID 103795220**: Navigation/Search Tab (Booking.com Grand Rapids Search Results)

---

### 1. Zillow Rental Benchmark (Grand Rapids, MI)
- **Property**: Diamond Place Apartments (Unit 242)
- **Address**: 1037 Michigan St NE #242, Grand Rapids, MI 49503
- **Monthly Rent**: **$1,512 / month** (within the $1,400–$2,400 filter)
- **Features**: 1 Bedroom, 1 Bathroom, in-unit laundry, on-site fitness center, modern amenities, central Grand Rapids location.
- **Monthly Benchmark**: **$1,512 / month**

---

### 2. Live Craigslist Grand Rapids Living Setups (Under $1,512 Benchmark)
All three listings were navigated to and verified as active, live postings on Craigslist:

1. **Hybrid 2008 Trail-Cruiser C21RBH by R-Vision**
   - **Price**: $1,250 (one-time purchase price)
   - **Location**: Wayland, MI (between Grand Rapids and Kalamazoo)
   - **Link**: https://www.craigslist.org/view/d/wayland-hybrid-2008-trail-cruiser/177gRoAsgEKh1YGqAhHhSL
   - **Details**: Full live-in camper trailer layout with kitchen/bath amenities and optional expandable tent ends.

2. **20 Foot Camper**
   - **Price**: $850
   - **Location**: Ovid, MI
   - **Link**: https://www.craigslist.org/view/d/ovid-20-foot-camper/s3GavRm12W6RMpXDR8Z1QF
   - **Details**: 20 ft camper with working AC and refrigerator, clear title, needing minor cosmetic/door work.

3. **Pop Up Camper (Coleman)**
   - **Price**: $500
   - **Location**: Cedar Springs, MI
   - **Link**: https://www.craigslist.org/view/d/cedar-springs-pop-up-camper/uwaALojrbLxYbEQTJqAnBA
   - **Details**: Low-cost compact Coleman pop-up camper setup suitable for seasonal/dry shelter.

*(Note: Each of these complete camper/trailer living setups costs less as a total purchase than a single month’s rent at the Zillow benchmark of $1,512).*

---

### 3. Booking.com Temporary Stay Fallback
- **Hotel**: Country Inn & Suites by Radisson, Grand Rapids East, MI
- **Address**: 3251 Deposit Drive, Grand Rapids, MI 49546
- **Overall Guest Review Score**: **9.1 / 10 ("Wonderful")** based on 1,352 verified reviews
  - Subscores: Cleanliness 9.3 | Staff 9.3 | Comfort 9.3 | Location 9.3 | Facilities 9.2 | Value for Money 8.9 | WiFi 8.4

**Key Takeaways from Recent Guest Reviews**:
1. **Exceptional Quiet and Comfort**: Guests consistently note that rooms are unusually well-soundproofed, clean, spacious, and provide comfortable beds for a restful stay.
2. **Quality Amenities & Convenient Surroundings**: Reviewers praise the indoor pool and hot tub, lobby cookies, and immediate proximity to dining (such as Gravity Taphouse next door) while being only ~5 miles from downtown Grand Rapids.
3. **Breakfast & Upkeep Mixed Notes**: While a full hot breakfast is included and appreciated for convenience, multiple guests report that breakfast quality can be uneven (preferring lobby coffee over machine coffee) and that high-traffic breakfast seating could use refreshes.

---

### 4. Comparison & Recommendation

- **How They Stack Up**:
  - **Traditional Rental ($1,512/mo)**: Provides turnkey stability, modern appliances, fitness center, and urban neighborhood walkability, but locks you into annual leases, background checks, utility bills, and fixed monthly overhead.
  - **Craigslist Living Setup ($500–$1,250 total)**: Massive cost savings on paper—the entire purchase is cheaper than one month of apartment rent. However, it requires legal land/lot rental, hookups (water, sewer, electric), heating preparations for Michigan winters, and vehicle towing capability.
  - **Hotel Fallback (~$110–$140/night)**: Zero commitment, fully furnished, includes utilities/wifi/daily breakfast, and eliminates immediate moving stress while inspecting long-term housing options in person.

- **Recommendation for a Temporary Stay**:
  The **Country Inn & Suites by Radisson, Grand Rapids East** is clearly the better-reviewed and most reliable option for a temporary transition base (rated **9.1/10 across 1,350+ reviews**). Its high comfort, cleanliness, and soundproofing scores provide a predictable, hassle-free environment to conduct property visits before committing either to an apartment lease or to the maintenance and site logistics of a camper/trailer.
